system.description:
When this dirge is sung, any character without the Spite or Hatred attribute within the presence of the caster must test his Steel. Extra song successes increase the obstacle for the Steel test. Use the hesitation options as described under Intense Sorrow.

Obstacle: 3

Actions: 3

Dark Elf spell song: follows the rules for Elven spell songs (sorcerous for practice and learning, always open-ended, no tools or FoRKs).

Song root: Will.

Restrictions: Dark Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 422
